item.title: We’re launching the first iteration of the AI & Economy ATLAS (Activity, Task, Landscape, and Adoption Study), the most comprehensive study to date o...
item.description:
We’re launching the first iteration of the AI & Economy ATLAS (Activity, Task, Landscape, and Adoption Study), the most comprehensive study to date on how people are actually using Google’s AI products and tools.
Based on 15 million de-identified interactions across more than 800 occupations, the data shows how people are using AI at work and at home:
💡 Collaboration over automation: At work, AI is primarily used for ideation and strategy, with less than 10% of interactions fully automating tasks. 🛠️ Beyond the desk: Workers in manual and technical trades are using AI as a live collaborator for real-time troubleshooting. 🏠 Everyday value: 86% of all AI interactions are happening outside of work, helping people navigate high-friction daily tasks. 🌍 Global growth: Global AI adoption is tracking GDP per capita, with exceptions. ATLAS data shows AI usage in 217 countries and territories that represent 99% of the world's population.
Learn more about our ATLAS report → https://goo.gle/4fhlbKX

item.title: "There's something magical that happens when you don't give up and learn to stay. Stay uncomfortable. Stay uncertain. The growth that awaits on the ot...
item.description:
"There's something magical that happens when you don't give up and learn to stay. Stay uncomfortable. Stay uncertain. The growth that awaits on the other side of that transforms you,” says Cristina, a Technical Program Manager on our Google Global Infrastructure (GGI) team.
Leaning into the unknown is exactly how she tackles some of our biggest scaling challenges. She oversees the operations, strategy, and budget to deploy our global physical network and high-performance TPUs (Tensor Processing Units—Google's custom AI chips designed to train massive machine learning models). Her core operating philosophy for managing these complex, fast-moving operations is incredibly simple: "Simplify, standardize, automate. In that order."
Cristina’s career advice for anyone navigating a new team or a big career pivot? Don't assume everyone else has the answers. Ask questions, embrace the learning curve, and don't be afraid to sit with the discomfort of growing.
Want to grow your career with Google? See what Technical Program Manager opportunities are waiting for you on the Cloud team → https://goo.gle/4pvBibb

item.title: “Building the physical infrastructure for America’s future requires significantly increasing the pipeline of skilled tradespeople across the country...
item.description:
“Building the physical infrastructure for America’s future requires significantly increasing the pipeline of skilled tradespeople across the country – a challenge that can only be addressed with collective action.” — Ruth Porat on our new Skilled Trades Alliance in partnership with BlackRock, Carhartt, and Ford Motor Company.
To help meet the growing demand for skilled trades workers, Google is joining forces with BlackRock, Carhartt, and Ford to launch the Alliance for America’s Skilled Trades. Together we'll expand apprenticeships, modernize training, and help fill hundreds of thousands of open jobs.
We're starting with training programs across 30 states, with the goal of expanding nationwide. To multiply our impact, the alliance is focusing on three key areas: -Building a stronger pipeline for the skilled trades. -Scaling proven, evidence-based training approaches. -Inviting new partners to help expand opportunities nationwide.
 Learn more about the alliance in this Fortune op-ed co-authored by the founding companies. https://lnkd.in/gBRBbQ7E

item.title: The best part about landing an internship as part of your graduate degree? Getting to solve real-world problems alongside the engineers who built the ...
item.description:
The best part about landing an internship as part of your graduate degree? Getting to solve real-world problems alongside the engineers who built the systems you learned about.
After moving from India to the US to pursue his graduate degree, Smit landed a Software Engineering internship at Google, where he’s getting hands-on exposure to some of the world's most complex computing systems. Today, his day-to-day tasks directly impact the physical foundations keeping the internet online.
“I wanted to be part of a collaborative culture that continuously pushes the boundaries of innovation,” he explains. “Knowing that Google operates some of the most complex computing infrastructure in the world, I was eager to gain hands-on experience optimizing the systems that power the cloud.”
Ready to take your advanced research from theory to planet-scale production? Explore our student and early career roles → https://goo.gle/4fLm38J

item.title: On our Q2 2026 earnings call, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai recapped an amazing quarter, with our AI investments redefining what’s possible a...
item.description:
On our Q2 2026 earnings call, Google and Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai recapped an amazing quarter, with our AI investments redefining what’s possible across every part of our business. Learn more ⬇️Q2 was an amazing quarter, with our AI investments redefining what’s possible across every part of our business.
Alphabet revenue grew 24% YoY and Google Cloud accelerated to 82% growth. We saw exciting momentum across the board from Search to YouTube to the Gemini app (which reached 950M monthly active users). Our model APIs are processing 22B tokens/min (up from 16B+ last quarter) driven by our workhorse Flash models. We’re also seeing great adoption of Gemini Enterprise, used by 90% of the Fortune 100, as well as strong demand for our security solutions.
Outstanding results and momentum, and such an exciting moment—thanks to all of our partners and employees around the world! 🙌
Read my full remarks here: https://lnkd.in/gBN2EJMm
